description_en: Calls the ExecDatamask operation to perform dynamic data masking
description_zh: 调用ExecDatamask接口对数据进行动态脱敏
name: ExecDatamask

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the ID of the masking template. After you create a template in the Data Security Center console (https://yundun.console.aliyun.com/?p=sddp#/dm/dmConfig/cn-zhangjiakou), the system generates a template ID. You can obtain the template ID on the Masking Templates page by choosing Data Masking > Masking Configuration > Masking Templates.

If the matching type of the masking template is Field Name, the system uses dataHeaderList in Data for matching.
If the matching type of the masking template is Sensitive Type, the system uses ruleList in Data for matching
parameters.help_zh:
指定脱敏模板ID。在数据安全中心控制台 (https://yundun.console.aliyun.com/?p=sddp#/dm/dmConfig/cn-zhangjiakou)上新建模板后会生成模板ID，您可以在数据脱敏>脱敏配置>脱敏模板页面获取模板ID。

若脱敏模板匹配类型是字段名称，则取Data中的dataHeaderList进行匹配。
若脱敏模板匹配类型是敏感类型，则取Data中的ruleList进行匹配
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the data to be masked. The value is a JSON string that contains the following fields:

dataHeaderList: the column names of the data. The order of the column names corresponds to the order of the data to be masked.

dataList: the data to be masked.

ruleList: the list of sensitive type IDs. The order of the IDs corresponds to the order of the data to be masked. A sensitive type ID is a number. Different numbers represent different sensitive types. You can obtain the IDs by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/410141.html operation
parameters.help_zh:
指定需要脱敏的数据。采用JSON格式的字符串表述，包含以下字段：

dataHeaderList：数据的列名，顺序和需要脱敏的数据一一对应。

dataList：需要脱敏的数据。

ruleList ：敏感类型ID列表，顺序和需要脱敏的数据一一对应。
                        敏感类型ID是数字，不同的数字代表不同的敏感类型，可通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/410141.html接口获取
parameters.name: data

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the language of the request and response. Default value: zh_cn. Valid values:

zh_cn: Simplified Chinese
en_us: English (US)
parameters.help_zh:
设置请求和返回消息的语言类型。默认值为zh_cn。取值

zh_cn：简体中文
en_us：英文（美国）
parameters.name: lang

Data.description_en:
The masked data. The value is a JSON string that contains the following fields:

dataHeaderList: the column names of the masked data.

dataList: the masked data. The order of the fields corresponds to the order of the column names.

ruleList: the sensitive type IDs, which correspond to the unique IDs of the sensitive types returned by the [DescribeRules]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/410141.html） operation
Data.description_zh:
脱敏完成后的数据，采用JSON格式的字符串表述。包含以下字段：

dataHeaderList：表示脱敏数据的列名。

dataList：表示需要脱敏的数据。字段顺序和脱敏数据的列名一致。

ruleList : 敏感类型ID，分别对应[DescribeRules]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/410141.html）返回值中的敏感类型唯一ID

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. The ID is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
